summary: Bitcoin is the first decentralized cryptocurrency, created in 2009 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. It operates on a peer-to-peer network using blockchain technology and proof-of-work mining. Over the years, it has seen significant adoption, regulatory scrutiny, and price volatility, including becoming legal tender in El Salvador (later revoked) and the establishment of strategic reserves in the US.

claims.text: Bitcoin was invented in 2008 by an unknown person using the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto.
claims.evidence_quote: bitcoin was invented in 2008 when an unknown person published a white paper under the pseudonym of Satoshi Nakamoto.

claims.text: The first known commercial transaction using bitcoin was the purchase of two Papa John's pizzas for 10,000 bitcoins on May 22, 2010.
claims.evidence_quote: On 22 May 2010, the first known commercial transaction using bitcoin occurred when programmer Laszlo Hanyecz bought two Papa John's pizzas for ₿10,000

claims.text: Bitcoin's supply is capped at 21 million coins.
As of June 2026, the circulating supply of bitcoin was approximately 20,057,778 BTC.
The block reward for mining bitcoin was 3.125 BTC as of 2026.
Bitcoin mining consumes large quantities of electricity, with surveyed miners reporting that 52% of their electricity use came from sustainable energy sources.
claims.evidence_quote: Mining consumes large quantities of electricity, with surveyed miners reporting that 52% of their electricity use came from sustainable energy sources

claims.text: El Salvador adopted bitcoin as legal tender in September 2021, but a January 2025 reform effectively ended its legal-tender status in practice.
claims.evidence_quote: In September 2021, bitcoin became legal tender currency in El Salvador, alongside the US dollar. ... a January 2025 reform removed obligations for businesses and the government to accept it, so many analysts regard its legal-tender status as effectively ended in practice.

claims.text: In December 2024, bitcoin's price reached $100,000 for the first time.
claims.evidence_quote: In December 2024, bitcoin price reached $100,000 for the first time

claims.text: In March 2025, President Trump signed an executive order to establish a strategic bitcoin reserve.
claims.evidence_quote: In March 2025, President Trump signed an executive order to establish a strategic bitcoin reserve.

claims.text: The first US spot bitcoin ETFs began trading in January 2024.
claims.evidence_quote: In January 2024, the first 11 US spot bitcoin ETFs began trading

claims.text: Bitcoin's market capitalization reached $1 trillion for the first time in February 2021.
claims.evidence_quote: In February 2021, bitcoin's market capitalization reached $1 trillion for the first time.

claims.text: The genesis block contained the headline 'The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks'.
claims.evidence_quote: Embedded in this block was the text "The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks"

claims.text: Bitcoin is pseudonymous, and its use by criminals has attracted regulatory attention, leading to bans in several countries.
claims.evidence_quote: As bitcoin is pseudonymous, its use by criminals has attracted the attention of regulators, leading to its ban by several countries.
